title: Transport rate limiting, timeout, and retry audit
decisions: HTTP 429 and 5xx responses, plus normalized network failures (status 0), are retryable through the same bounded retry policy.
Tests verify configured timeout propagation to injected senders, runtime/request budget enforcement, HTTP retry, and network-error retry without real sleeps or network access.
risks: Backoff remains deterministic and bounded but has no jitter; production callers may add policy-level jitter later without changing adapters.
Existing mypy errors in the source sector predate this task and remain tracked separately.
